import urllib.request
import json

# Let's query NCBI gene for CNOT3 and RTF2
def get_ncbi_gene_summary(gene_id):
    url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi?db=gene&id={gene_id}&retmode=json"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
        return json.loads(resp.read().decode())

def search_ncbi_gene(query):
    url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esearch.fcgi?db=gene&term={urllib.parse.quote(query)}&retmode=json"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
        return json.loads(resp.read().decode())

print("CNOT3 NCBI Search:", cnot3_search)

# Let's fetch the protein sequences for CNOT3 and RTF2 from NCBI RefSeq
import urllib.request
import json

def get_refseq_proteins(gene_id):
    # efetch for gene
    url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/efetch.fcgi?db=gene&id={gene_id}&retmode=xml"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
        xml_data = resp.read().decode()
    return xml_data

# Or let's query NCBI protein directly for NP_ accessions
def search_ncbi_protein(query):
    url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esearch.fcgi?db=protein&term={urllib.parse.quote(query)}&retmode=json"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
        return json.loads(resp.read().decode())

def get_protein_summary(id_list):
    ids = ",".join(id_list)
    url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi?db=protein&id={ids}&retmode=json"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
        return json.loads(resp.read().decode())

cnot3_prot_search = search_ncbi_protein("CNOT3[Gene Name] AND Homo sapiens[Organism] AND refseq[filter]")
print("CNOT3 proteins:", cnot3_prot_search["esearchresult"]["idlist"])
cnot3_prot_sum = get_protein_summary(cnot3_prot_search["esearchresult"]["idlist"][:5])
for pid in cnot3_prot_search["esearchresult"]["idlist"][:5]:
    item = cnot3_prot_sum["result"][pid]
    print(item["accessionversion"], item["title"], item["slen"])
